summary: Fix correctly preserves the figure's original DPI across the FigureCanvasBase re-init during unpickling, addressing the M1 DPI-doubling root cause with a minimal 3-line change. Targeted, low-risk, and consistent with the surrounding __setstate__ code.

issues.description: Save/restore around FigureCanvasBase(self) is a bit of a workaround for the canvas re-init side effect rather than fixing the DPI mutation at its source, but it is a reasonable and safe pattern here.
